steps.text:
分析（1）由题意知 $\beta = b\alpha_{1} + c\alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}$ ，等式两边对应分量相等就可求得 $a, b, c$ 的值；

（2）若 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 线性无关，则它就是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的一个基；将 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 用 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表示，就能得到过渡矩阵.

解（1）由题意 $\pmb{\beta} = b\pmb{\alpha}_1 + c\pmb{\alpha}_2 + \pmb{\alpha}_3$ ，即

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} b + c + 1 = 1, \\ 2 b + 3 c + a = 1, \\ b + 2 c + 3 = 1. \end{array} \right.
$$

解得 $a = 3, b = 2, c = -2$ .

(2) 因为 $\left|\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta\right|=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\ 3&3&1\\ 2&3&1\end{vmatrix}=2\neq0$ ，所以 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 线性无关，从而构成 $R^{3}$ 的一个基.
由 $\beta=2\alpha_{1}-2\alpha_{2}+\alpha_{3}$ ，有

$$
\left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & - 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

所以从 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 到 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 的过渡矩阵为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & - 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & 0 \\ - 1 / 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 / 2 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

分析（1）由题意知 $\beta = b\alpha_{1} + c\alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}$ ，等式两边对应分量相等就可求得 $a, b, c$ 的值；

（2）若 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 线性无关，则它就是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的一个基；将 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 用 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表示，就能得到过渡矩阵.

解（1）由题意 $\pmb{\beta} = b\pmb{\alpha}_1 + c\pmb{\alpha}_2 + \pmb{\alpha}_3$ ，即

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} b + c + 1 = 1, \\ 2 b + 3 c + a = 1, \\ b + 2 c + 3 = 1. \end{array} \right.
$$

解得 $a = 3, b = 2, c = -2$ .

(2) 因为 $\left|\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta\right|=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\ 3&3&1\\ 2&3&1\end{vmatrix}=2\neq0$ ，所以 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 线性无关，从而构成 $R^{3}$ 的一个基.
由 $\beta=2\alpha_{1}-2\alpha_{2}+\alpha_{3}$ ，有

$$
\left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & - 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

所以从 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta$ 到 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 的过渡矩阵为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & - 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & 0 \\ - 1 / 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 / 2 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

评注 设 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 与 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\cdots,\beta_{n}$ 是 n 维空间 V 的两个基，若有 n 阶矩阵 P，使得

$$
\left(\beta_ {1}, \beta_ {2}, \dots , \beta_ {n}\right) = \left(\alpha_ {1}, \alpha_ {2}, \dots , \alpha_ {n}\right) P,
$$

则称 P 是从基 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n}$ 到 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{n}$ 的过渡矩阵.

设向量 $\gamma\in V$ 在基 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 下的坐标为 $X=(x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n})^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，在基 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\cdots,\beta_{n}$ 下的坐标为 $Y=(y_{1},y_{2},\cdots,y_{n})^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，则有坐标变换公式：X=PY 或 $Y=P^{-1}X$ 。
